description: This file defines API handlers for managing boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including creating, patching, and deleting boards and blocks, with permission checks and audit logging.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler class with methods for managing boards and blocks

methods.name: registerBoardsAndBlocksRoutes
methods.description: Registers API routes for boards and blocks management

methods.name: handleCreateBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Handles creation of new boards and blocks with validation and permission checks

methods.name: handlePatchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Handles patching (updating) of existing boards and blocks with validation and permission checks

methods.name: handleDeleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Handles deletion of specified boards and blocks with permission validation
